goals.2: Saying your age: Ich bin … Jahre alt
goals.3: All the forms of sein: ich bin, du bist, er ist …
dialog.0.de.3.n: In a question the verb comes first, then du
dialog.1.de.1.n: ich bin — not „haben“! Ich habe 23 is wrong
dialog.1.de.2.n: drei + und + zwanzig = “three and twenty” — the unit comes first
dialog.2.de.0.n: Said as a question, it shows surprise or checking
dialog.3.de.1.n: Informal word; der Opa (you'll learn family words in the next unit)
dialog.3.de.3.n: You can say hundert without ein
grammar.0.title: Units first, then tens
grammar.0.text: 21 einundzwanzig · 22 zweiundzwanzig · 34 vierunddreißig · 45 fünfundvierzig · 99 neunundneunzig. Remember: the order is “three-and-twenty”, like old-fashioned English “three and twenty”. 30 is dreißig (ß, not -zig); in 60 sechzig and 70 siebzig, sechs and sieben are shortened.
grammar.1.intro: To give your age and say who you are, use „sein“ (to be). It is irregular — learn the full forms together.
grammar.1.note: Even if you would say “my age is 23” in Bangla, you cannot use „haben“ in German: correct — Ich bin 23 Jahre alt. Wrong — Ich habe 23 Jahre.
